title: Method Cases Seed Data Schema
description: JSON Schema for Rubik's Cube method case seed data files (seeddata_cases_*.json). Each case represents an individual algorithm case (e.g., 'T Perm', 'F2L-01-FR', 'OLL-21').

code.description: Unique code identifier for the case (e.g., 'T-Perm', 'F2L-01-FR', 'OLL-21', 'CLL-AS-01')

case_set_id.description: Foreign key reference to case sets table (optional, some cases may not belong to a set)

long_name.description: Full descriptive name for the case

kind.description: Case kind/type. Values are dynamically discovered from database. Common values include: 'f2l', 'oll', 'pll', 'cll', 'ortega_oll', 'ortega_pbl', 'lbl_daisy', 'unspecified'

pattern_from.description: Pattern state before solving this case (serialized representation)

pattern_to.description: Pattern state after solving this case (serialized representation)

scramble.description: Scramble notation sequence to reach this case from solved state
examples: R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'

notes.description: General notes about the case (recognition tips, common errors, etc.)

story.description: Story or mnemonic for remembering the case recognition or solution

description.description: Detailed description of the case and its characteristics

image_url.description: Cloud URL to case image in Supabase Storage (primary image source)

image_asset_name.description: Bundled asset name in app bundle (fallback image source). Format: caseimg_{code}

popularity.description: Popularity score from 0 (least popular) to 100 (most popular)

groups.description: Recognition groups for multi-dimensional categorization. Each string follows 'category:value' format (e.g., 'slot:FR', 'level:beginner', 'puzzle:2x2')

items.description: Group in 'category:value' format (allows letters, numbers, underscore, hyphen, and slash)

created_at.description: Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format with timezone

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format with timezone

description: Array must contain at least one case
